*note: Mnemonics are written in single quotes inside PRINT/INPUT lists, e.g. PRINT 'CS','BR',"Hello",'ER'. Many accept arguments: 'FONT'("Arial",-10), 'COLOUR'(...). Graphics mnemonics (ARC, BOX, CIRCLE, LINE, PIE, POLYGON, RECTANGLE, FILL, PEN ...) draw on a graphical window or Windows printer channel.

ARC.doc: Draw an arc on a graphical window or Windows printer.

BACKGR.doc: Background: subsequent output is written to the background (non-highlighted) text layer / sets background attributes.

BEEP.doc: Sound a beep; requires an argument in 9.62 (e.g. 'BEEP'("x")) â€” for a plain bell use 'RB'.

BLACK.doc: Set the foreground (text) colour to black.

BLUE.doc: Set the foreground (text) colour to blue.

BOX.doc: Draw a box. Text form: 'BOX'(col,line,width,height[,title$]); also used on graphical channels.

BX.doc: Draw a box using box-drawing characters (short form of 'BOX').

CAPTION.doc: Set the caption (title bar text) of the current window: 'CAPTION'(text$).

CIRCLE.doc: Draw a circle/ellipse on a graphical window or Windows printer.

COLOUR.doc: Set foreground/background colours, e.g. 'COLOUR'(fg,bg) or by colour name/RGB string.

CPI.doc: Characters per inch for printer output: 'CPI'(n).

CYAN.doc: Set the foreground (text) colour to cyan.

DEFAULT.doc: Reset colours/attributes (and fonts) of the window to the defaults.

DIALOGUE.doc: Display a window as a dialogue (modal style window).

DROP.doc: Drop (close) the current or named window: 'DROP'(n) / 'DROP'("name").

FILL.doc: Set the fill pattern/colour used by subsequent graphic shapes.

FLOOD.doc: Flood-fill an area on a graphical window.

FONT.doc: Select the font for subsequent text: 'FONT'(name$, size[, style$]).

FRAME.doc: Draw a frame / framed box on a window.

GREEN.doc: Set the foreground (text) colour to green.

LPI.doc: Lines per inch for printer output: 'LPI'(n).

MAGENTA.doc: Set the foreground (text) colour to magenta.

MAXSIZE.doc: Set the maximum size of the current (resizable) window.

MESSAGE.doc: Display a message on the message/status line of the window.

MINSIZE.doc: Set the minimum size of the current (resizable) window.

MODE.doc: Set the drawing mode / pen mode used for graphics output.

OFFSET.doc: Set an offset (origin) for subsequent output, e.g. printer margins: 'OFFSET'(x,y).

PEN.doc: Set the pen (line) colour, width and style for graphic shapes: 'PEN'(width,colour[,style]).

PICTURE.doc: Display a picture (bitmap) file in a region of the window: 'PICTURE'(col,line,width,height,file$[,mode]).

POLYGON.doc: Draw a polygon from a list of points.

POP.doc: Pop (restore) the previously saved window, removing the current one.

PUSH.doc: Push (save) the current window state so it can be restored by 'POP'.

RED.doc: Set the foreground (text) colour to red.

SCROLL.doc: Define a scrolling region within the window: 'SCROLL'(col,line,width,height).

SHOW.doc: Show / bring the window to the front (optionally a given state).

TEXT.doc: Output text at a graphic position: 'TEXT'(x,y,text$).

WG.doc: Window graphical: graphical window definition mnemonic.

WHITE.doc: Set the foreground (text) colour to white.

WRAP.doc: Control automatic line wrap at the right margin.

YELLOW.doc: Set the foreground (text) colour to yellow.

_BLACK.doc: Set the background colour to black.

_BLUE.doc: Set the background colour to blue.

_CYAN.doc: Set the background colour to cyan.

_GREEN.doc: Set the background colour to green.

_MAGENTA.doc: Set the background colour to magenta.

_RED.doc: Set the background colour to red.

_WHITE.doc: Set the background colour to white.

_YELLOW.doc: Set the background colour to yellow.

CS.doc: Clear screen (the current window) and home the cursor.

CE.doc: Clear from cursor to end of screen (window).

CL.doc: Clear from cursor to end of line.

SB.doc: Set background: subsequent output is background (protected/normal) text.

SF.doc: Set foreground: subsequent output is foreground (unprotected/data) text.

FF.doc: Form feed (new page on printers; clears the window on terminals).

LD.doc: Line delete: delete the current line, scrolling lines below up.

LI.doc: Line insert: insert a blank line at the cursor, scrolling lines below down.
